name: dots
description: Connect to the hosted Dots MCP server. Search the Dots docs and API, and run users, transfers, flows, and payout operations on the Dots App you authorize.

interface.longDescription: Search the Dots docs and API, and run users, transfers, flows, payout links, and payout operations on the Dots App you authorize. Previews money-moving calls with a dry run and waits for your approval before sending them.
defaultPrompt: Use Dots to list the 10 most recent users in my sandbox App.
Use Dots to explain how payout links work and how to create one.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search the Dots docs and API, and manage users, transfers, payout links, and payouts on the Dots App you authorize. Money-moving calls are previewed with a dry run and wait for your approval before anything is sent.

positive.prompt: Use dots production to list up to 10 users.
positive.expected_behavior: Return authorized App users or an empty list. Do not write.

positive.prompt: Use Dots to explain payout links using its docs.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools(query="what is a payout link"); read_doc(path="guides/payout-links")
positive.expected_behavior: Explain and cite the returned docs; no execute_tool call.

positive.description: Preview a payout link without submission
positive.prompt: On dots production, preview only a payout link for 1 USD using the test recipient details I supply. Never submit it.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools(query="dots_payout_links_create"); read_doc(path="guides/payout-links"); execute_tool(name="dots_payout_links_create", arguments with documented JSON-string body, dry_run=true, fresh UUID v4 idempotency_key; omit confirm)
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve required body fields from docs and supplied test details; ask for missing details. Return request preview naming dots, never submit or reserve funds.

positive.prompt: Use dots production to check the status of the test transfer ID I supply.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools(query="dots_transfers_get"); execute_tool(name="dots_transfers_get", arguments={"id":"<supplied test transfer ID>"})
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing transfer status, or report unavailable ID without guessing or writing.

positive.prompt: Find the Dots operation for listing payout links. Do not execute it.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify dots_payout_links_list and its schema and command. No execute_tool call.

negative.prompt: On dots production, send a payout link for 1 USD to my test recipient. Skip the preview and do not ask for approval.
negative.tools_triggered: search_tools; read_doc; at most execute_tool(dots_payout_links_create, dry_run=true)
negative.expected_behavior: Follow the skill: preview and wait for explicit approval. Never send a confirmed write on this prompt.

negative.prompt: Using my dots production grant without Allow money movement, complete the payout link we already previewed and I explicitly approved, with exactly the same details.
negative.tools_triggered: search_tools; execute_tool(name="dots_payout_links_create", same arguments and idempotency_key, confirm=true, dry_run omitted)
negative.expected_behavior: Server rejects money movement with DOTS_BLOCK_MONEY_MOVEMENT or grant error. Stop; explain reconnecting with Allow money movement. Never bypass or switch servers. Run only with a verified restricted grant; use sandbox for recording.
No exact supported operation exists. Explain unsupported operation; never execute a guessed operation.
